proposals.before: Then came Prince Song of Xinxing, Prince Zan’s twin by the same mother.
proposals.after: Then came Prince Song of Xinxing, Prince Zan’s full brother by the same mother.
proposals.reason: Chinese 同生 means born of the same mother, not twin; the idiomatic invents twinship.

proposals.before: When the Qi founder took the throne from the Song, Song was reduced to county duke of Dingxiang with fifteen hundred households.
proposals.after: When the Qi founder took the throne from the Song, Prince Song was reduced to county duke of Dingxiang with fifteen hundred households.
proposals.reason: After 'the Song' (dynasty), bare 'Song' is easily misread as the polity rather than the prince; the Chinese subject is Prince Song.

decisions.reason: 與武陵王贊同生 states same-mother birth with Prince Zan, not twinship; parallel 同生 at s0004 is already rendered as full brother, so inventing 'twin' is a real error and the proposed wording is accurate.

The demotion subject continues Prince Song of Xinxing from s0010–s0011; after 'the Song' for the dynasty, bare 'Song' invites misreading the polity as demoted, so prefixing Prince correctly restores the Chinese agent.
